_source: Built mechanically from the facts of CBP ruling H345343 (2025-07-21, development Part 102 split; subject: "Origin; USMCA Eligibility; Section 301 Measures; Plastic Chairs"). D570 rules on development data for the D590 error analysis. CBP held United States. Components: the D362 materials; part codes: the top D381 development suggestion (unverified, D382); the good's code: CBP's (9401.79.00). Family: the family check (furniture, 0.95); name from the subject (D381 rule). Materials with no country left out (0: none). Groups: one model call with the production extractor's group rule (groups-dev-set.jsonl). Plants one per country; operations one per group and plant plus final assembly in Mexico. Target China by the D171 rule counted mechanically; plant capabilities for China are an assumption. Economics illustrative. D590.
